headline: Review of initial STAR assessment results, technology and AI guidance, math instruction concerns, and Act 139 compliance for schools.
summary: The meeting will review the initial implementation of STAR assessments and their results, including next steps. It will also cover technology use, AI guidance, math instruction concerns, and Act 139 compliance and interventions.
